BROOKLYN NIGHTS 3D

MILES MORALES

ACROSS THE SPIDER-VERSE

Swing through a 3D Brooklyn with Spider-Gwen at your side, wall-crawl skyscrapers, stop 8 rooftop crimes, then take down the Rhino, Venom, the Spot and the Prowler. Then Act II: the Sinister Ten, from Scorpion and Electro to Kingpin and Carnage.

WASD move · Mouse look · Space jump / double jump · Hold left mouse or Shift web-swing · J / right mouse punch · E web shot · K Venom Strike · L camouflage

Esc pause · F fullscreen · V comic / realistic look · G Gwen on / off · T talk to Gwen (🎤 or Y to speak) · N / B cycle suits · M soundtrack (Brooklyn Nights · Sunflower · off) · U Tech Lab: spend tech points on web shooters and skills

Touch: left stick moves, drag the right side to look, buttons for the rest.
